notes.title: What Happened Here Bug Report #2
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is Noel from Muna Games Studio.[/p][p]There were several bugs that we fixed this time.[/p][p][/p][p]Major bugs:[/p][p]- A bug where you couldn't get the normal ending scene[/p][p]- A bug in the garden puzzle where you couldn't pick up Abby on your second garden mistake[/p][p]- A bug where collisions stopped working after your second garden mistake[/p][p][/p][p]Minor bug:[/p][p]- A bug where the flower event blocked your way from moving on the left side of the garden.[/p][p][/p][p]I am deeply sorry for the inconvenience my mistakes have caused in playing the game. I really hope it didn't taint your gaming experience that much. I am still learning how to develop efficiently and properly.[/p][p]Happy gaming,[/p][p]Muna Games Studio.[/p]

notes.title: What Happened Here Has Officially Released!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="-U90bWGGXk4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is Noel from Muna Games Studio.ːpmcrystalː[/p][p][b]What Happened Here![/b] Is officially out, please give it a lot of love![/p][p]As we’re a sole developer, and the game has been mostly tested by me, there’s prone to be some bugs. If you encountered any, please report them to me so I could add them on the bug list and fix them.[/p][p]I will release an official walkthrough soon. If you’re struggling with 100% completing the game, please wait for a bit longer.[/p][p][b]About Steam Achievements:[/b] I’m still unsure if they’re 100% working or not. I am struggling with RPG maker MZ Steam plugin and I’m unsure how much of it is within my control. I will do my best within my capabilities to get them working, at least for Windows players.[/p][p]If any of you reading this are experienced RPG maker developer with experience putting achievements on Steam, please let me know as I would love some help![/p][p][b]About the secret ending:[/b] The full secret route will come out on the next major update, We deeply apologise for the inconvenience.[/p][p][b]About the support pack:[/b] currently, we only sell the OST as DLC for supporting the game. We’re taking a bit longer with the CGs to put them on a little art book. We think it’s something you’ll appreciate more and will add more value to you. More info will come out about it in time.[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting the game![/p][p]I will see you in a future game and future updates.[/p][p]Happy gaming,[/p][p]Muna Games Studio.[/p]
